create_averaged_weights: create an Averaged instance to maintain running averages of TensorFlow model weight tensors
test_take_sample: test the Averaged.take_sample method to accumulate a running average of model weights
refactor_switch_to_average: refactor the Averaged.switch_to_average method to swap model weights with their averaged values
review_restore_method: review the Averaged.restore method to revert model weights back to their saved pre-averaged values
summarize_reset_function: summarize the Averaged.reset function to reset the running sample counter to zero
